name: 14_transformer_load_edge_device

dataset.display_name: Electricity Transformer Temperature and Load Measurements (ETTm1)
dataset.split: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

business_question: Which transformer load/temperature model is most accurate on a substation edge device with a model-size and latency budget?

seeds.source: step-60000 neural policy (Rust/Candle CPU), produced by agy_resource_fitness; see seeds.provenance.json

why: A substation edge device forecasts transformer oil temperature from load readings. The model must fit the device's storage and answer each reading within a latency budget.
caveats: Time-ordered data, but jope pipeline run validates on an unordered fold partition of train.csv, so this case does not exercise chronological (regime) validation
